[narrator] Outside the thick viewing ports, the abyssal blackness presses inward, and a strange, wet scratching sound begins to echo faintly from just beneath the iron floorplates.

player_input: I close my eyes and wait for another 12 days

[narrator] Time loses all meaning within the iron coffin of the control room as another dozen days slip past in unbroken darkness. The air grows foul and thin in your lungs, smelling of stale sweat, rust, and quiet despair.
[narrator] Through the cold floorplates, a steady, rhythmic scraping begins—something massive and relentless, dragging itself closer from the depths below.

player_input: Curl into a tight ball against the back bulkhead and wait for the end

[narrator] The cold steel of the back bulkhead presses hard against your spine as you pull your knees to your chest, surrendering entirely to the dark. The scratching at the hatch grows louder, accompanied by a low, vibrating groan of tortured metal that shakes the very soul of the vessel.
[narrator] Darkness closes in like a tangible weight, swallowing the last ragged breath of air as the abyss finally reclaims its own.

player_input: Open your eyes to see what has broken through the hatch

[narrator] Something vast and eyeless shifts in the flooded darkness below, its pale appendages reaching up across the frost-rimed deck plates toward where you lie.

player_input: Reach out a trembling hand to touch the pale, reaching form

[narrator] The subsea entity closes its cold embrace around you, pulling you downward into the fathomless black where time and breath no longer exist.

player_input: Let the darkness take you
